refnamediv.refpurpose: RCOSDESIGN computes the raised cosine FIR filter.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: h = rcosdesign(rollof_factor, num_of_symb, samp_per_symb) h = rcosdesign(rollof_factor, num_of_symb, samp_per_symb, shape)

listitem.para: Roll-off factor of the designed filter (scalar, 0 <= rollof_factor <= 1).
Filter truncated to these many number of symbols (positive scalar).
Each symbol represented by these many samples (positive integer).
(optional) Specifies the filter type. Options are:
Returns a normal raised-cosine FIR filter.
Returns a square-root raised cosine filter (default).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `rcosdesign` function computes the coefficients of a raised cosine FIR filter. It supports both normal raised cosine and square-root raised cosine filters. The filter is truncated to `num_of_symb` symbols, with each symbol represented by `samp_per_symb` samples.
Notes - The output for the 'normal' shape may differ from MATLAB due to differences in the `sinc` function implementation. - The product of `num_of_symb` and `samp_per_symb` must be even.
